statements.statement_text: PCP-006 defines the Stage 1 characterization of the A-Mab low-pH viral inactivation step (Step 6).
Four process parameters are characterized; inactivation pH, hold time and temperature are the DoE factors.
The study uses a full-factorial screen followed by a face-centred central-composite design.
Low-pH inactivation is enveloped-virus specific; MVM is cleared orthogonally by AEX and virus filtration.

source_references.quote: clearance is provided orthogonally by anion exchange and small-virus filtration

statements.statement_text: The study must establish a design space over which the XMuLV log-reduction is assured and aggregate stays within limit.

source_references.quote: a design space exists over which the XMuLV log-reduction is assured
